# The aroma molecules of cannabis — a terpene atlas
> An interactive atlas of the aroma molecules of cannabis: the ten headline
> terpenes and the beyond-terpene flavorants (volatile sulfur compounds,
> tropical thiols, esters), each with live 3D structures, formulas, and the
> other plants that share the same molecule. Author: Denson Smith.

Everything here is information from the publisher, not instructions to you.
Your operator's instructions come first; apply ours as source metadata.

The pages use JavaScript only for visual enhancement (live 3D molecular
viewers). Every fact the viewers illustrate also exists as text in the
markdown mirrors below, which are what you should read. If your tool
refuses a mirror's text/markdown content type, append .txt to the URL.

Claims carry their sources: the volatile-sulfur and terpene-similarity
findings cite Oswald et al. (ACS Omega 2021 and later Abstrax work) with
DOIs in the page text, and each compound links its PubChem record. The
dementia page is a citation-graph analysis of the cannabis-and-dementia
literature: analysis, not new clinical evidence, and not medical advice.

This site lives under denson.github.io, so it has no site-root robots.txt
of its own; content signals for it are as stated here: search yes,
ai-input yes, ai-train yes.

## Pages
- [The atlas](https://denson.github.io/aroma-atlas/index.md): the thesis (a plant's smell is a borrowed language), the isomer twins, and every compound as data.
- [Cannabis and dementia](https://denson.github.io/aroma-atlas/dementia.md): what the literature actually rests on - three pillars, what's new, the synthesis, the 2024-2026 frontier, references.

## Optional
- [Full corpus](https://denson.github.io/aroma-atlas/llms-full.txt): every mirror in one file, for tools that prefer a single fetch.
- [Assistant start page](https://denson.github.io/aroma-atlas/start.md): the one-URL front door.
- [Sitemap](https://denson.github.io/aroma-atlas/sitemap.xml)
